title: Benchmarking CPU, GPU, and ML Power-Flow Solvers from 14 to 70,000 Buses
abstract: arXiv:2610.27930v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learned surrogates for power-flow (PF) computation are usually motivated by speed, compared against a single CPU-based baseline. We show this comparison is fragile: across 7 open-source CPU-based solvers evaluated on identical inputs, throughput varies by roughly 2.5-3 orders of magnitude, so the choice of baseline alone can flip the conclusion. We build a benchmark spanning 9 physics-based solvers: 7 CPU-based and 2 GPU-based, including a new batched GPU solver, gumsim2grid - and 3 published ML surrogates, evaluated under a shared, independently implemented KCL-mismatch check across 15 grids from 14 to 70,000 buses. On the PF task itself, a sufficiently parallelized CPU solver or gpusim2grid matches or exceeds the throughput of the ML surrogates we test while remaining orders of magnitude more accurate; we find no evidence that these GNN-style surrogates are yet competitive for PF specifically, though prior work reports genuine gains

translated_title: 从14节点到70,000节点的CPU、GPU与机器学习潮流求解器基准测试
translated_abstract: 学习型潮流计算替代模型通常以速度为卖点，并与单一的基于CPU的基线进行比较。我们表明这种比较是脆弱的：在相同输入上评估的7个开源CPU求解器中，吞吐量差异约为2.5-3个数量级，因此仅基线的选择就可能翻转结论。我们构建了一个基准，涵盖9个基于物理的求解器——7个基于CPU的和2个基于GPU的，包括一个新的批量GPU求解器gpusim2grid——以及3个已发表的机器学习替代模型，在共享的、独立实现的KCL失配检查下，对从14到70,000节点的15个电网进行了评估。在潮流计算任务本身上，充分并行化的CPU求解器或gpusim2grid的吞吐量达到甚至超过我们测试的机器学习替代模型，同时精度高出数个数量级；我们没有发现证据表明这些GNN风格的替代模型在潮流计算这一特定任务上已具备竞争力，尽管先前的工作报告了真实的收益。
tldr: 该论文构建了涵盖9个物理求解器和3个机器学习替代模型的潮流计算基准，揭示基线选择可令速度结论相差2.5-3个数量级，并证明充分并行化的CPU求解器或新的GPU求解器gpusim2grid在吞吐量上可比肩甚至超过ML替代模型，且精度高出数个数量级。
en_tdlr: This paper builds a benchmark of 9 physics-based solvers and 3 ML surrogates, showing that baseline choice alone can flip speed conclusions by 2.5-3 orders of magnitude, and that a sufficiently parallelized CPU solver or the new GPU solver gpusim2grid matches or exceeds ML surrogate throughput while remaining orders of magnitude more accurate.
